---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem / motivation

What are you trying to accomplish that the template doesn't support today?

## Proposed direction

A rough sketch of what a solution might look like. Module / file paths if you
know them. Alternatives you considered.

## Out of scope

If there are related ideas that should stay separate, list them here so the
discussion doesn't sprawl.

## Additional context

Links to related discussions, prior issues, or external references (docs,
upstream Terraform module patterns, NIST control guidance, etc.).
